author: thadeu
description: Ndb::Client talks HTTP to ndb over a unix socket or TCP: collections, documents with versions, queries, aggregates, watch streams and blobs. Stdlib only, no runtime dependencies. The daemon decides every query semantic.

author: thadeu
description: Ndb::Record, a lazy Relation, validations, blobs and a Rails railtie on top of the ndb client gem. The gem only builds JSON; the daemon decides every query semantic.

author: Marcos G. Zimmermann
